name: Campaign Brief
description: Full campaign brief covering objective, target audience, channels, budget breakdown, timeline phases, and creative direction.

campaign_name.description: Campaign name displayed in the header and title

date.description: Brief date string; omit to suppress

objective.description: Primary campaign objective and success metric

target_audience.description: Audience definition: { demographics: string, psychographics: string, segments: string[] }

channels.description: Array of channel objects: { name: string, budget_pct: number, notes?: string }

budget.description: Budget object: { total: string, breakdown: { line: string, amount: string }[] }

timeline.description: Array of phase objects: { phase: string, dates: string, tasks: string }

creative_direction.description: Visual style, tone of voice, key messages, and brand constraints
